name: standing glute squeeze
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed. Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips. Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can. Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively. Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.
instruction_steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed.
Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips.
Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can.
Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.

name: seated knee down
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with the soles of your feet together or one leg crossed in. Let one knee drop slowly out to the side toward the floor. Keep your back straight and your chest lifted as the knee lowers. Pause briefly at the end of the comfortable range, then lift the knee back up. Repeat for 8-12 reps per side.
instruction_steps: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with the soles of your feet together or one leg crossed in.
Let one knee drop slowly out to the side toward the floor.
Keep your back straight and your chest lifted as the knee lowers.

name: hydrotherapy walking on spot
instructions: Stand in waist-to-chest-deep water with your feet hip width apart. Lift one knee up in front of you, then lower it and lift the other. Swing your arms naturally and keep your posture tall. Walk at a relaxed, steady pace without leaning forward. Continue for 2-5 minutes at an easy to moderate effort.

name: weighted plate overhead reverse lunge
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms. Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees. Keep your ribs down and the plate stable over your head. Push through the front foot to return, then alternate legs.

Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.

Keep your ribs down and the plate stable over your head.
Push through the front foot to return, then alternate legs.

name: jump split
instructions: Start in a split stance with a slight lunge dip. Drop down and jump up powerfully. Switch leg positions in mid-air. Land softly in a lunge with the other leg in front. Keep your torso upright and repeat at a steady pace.

name: dynamic chest stretch (male)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart. Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground. Slowly bring your arms forward, crossing them in front of your body. Feel the stretch in your chest muscles. Hold the stretch for 10-30 seconds. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Slowly bring your arms forward, crossing them in front of your body.
Feel the stretch in your chest muscles.

name: lying (prone) abdominal stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders. Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable. Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes. Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly. Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.

Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.

name: seated groin stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together. Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out. Keep your back straight and chest lifted. Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch. Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

name: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
instructions: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off. Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line. Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back. Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching. Complete all reps, then switch legs.

Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.

name: 45 degree twisting hyperextension
instructions: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge. Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back. Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes. At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center. Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.

name: bodyweight rope pull up
instructions: Hang from two ropes with arms straight and legs together. Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down. Pull yourself up until your hands reach chest or chin level. Keep your elbows pointing down and close. Lower under control to a full hang.

name: bodyweight rope inverted row
instructions: Set ropes at about waist height and lie under them, holding the ends. Keep your body straight from heels to head, heels on the floor. Pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades. Keep your elbows close to your body. Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: weighted stone standing power overhead press
instructions: Lift the stone to your chest, hugging it close. Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your core. Dip slightly and drive up through your legs. Press the stone overhead to full lockout. Lower it back to your chest with control.

name: plyo push up v. 2
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders. Lower your chest toward the floor with control. Explode upward so your hands leave the ground. Land softly with slightly bent elbows. Reset your body line and repeat.

name: lever incline chest supported reverse delt fly (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the incline pad and grab the handles. Start with arms forward and slightly bent. Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc. Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end. Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

name: assisted weighted push up
instructions: Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back. Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line. Lower your chest toward the floor. Press back up until your elbows are straight. Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.

name: barbell incline wide reverse grip bench press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you. Unrack and hold the bar over your upper chest. Lower it to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked. Press back up to lockout. Use a spotter, as this grip is less stable.

name: diamond push up (on knees)
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond. Keep your body straight from knees to head. Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close. Press up until your arms are straight. Keep your core tight throughout.

name: dumbbell forward leaning lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart. Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back. Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees. Push through the front heel to return to standing. Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.

name: dumbbell incline front raise
instructions: Lie face down or back on an incline bench holding dumbbells. Start with your arms hanging or in front of you. Raise the weights forward to shoulder height with straight arms. Pause briefly at the top. Lower slowly under control.

name: smith bent over row (chest supported)
instructions: Set an incline bench under the bar and lie chest down on it. Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width. Pull the bar toward your lower ribs. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top. Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: cable seated incline curl
instructions: Set a bench to incline and place a low pulley behind you. Sit back with your arms hanging and grab the handles. Curl the handles toward your shoulders, keeping elbows back. Squeeze the biceps at the top. Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: cable standing single arm supinated grip chest press
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip. Stand facing away in a staggered stance. Press the handle forward until your arm is straight. Keep your torso still and resist twisting. Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

name: dumbbell lying hammer press v. 2

name: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step. Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance. Lower your heel to a full stretch. Press up onto your toes as high as possible. Complete your reps, then switch legs.

name: jump step box
instructions: Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart. Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back. Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees. Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time. Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.

name: lateral jump
instructions: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready. Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance. Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes. Immediately jump back to the starting side. Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.

name: explosive fingers
instructions: Hold your hands out in front of you. Close both hands into tight fists. Open them fast, spreading your fingers as wide as possible. Repeat quickly for 20-30 reps. Keep your wrists relaxed.

name: explosive hang squat
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent. Lower into a deep squat position. Explode upward through your legs. Absorb the movement softly and return to the start. Keep your core tight and repeat.

name: internal rotation shoulders mobilization
instructions: Stand or sit tall with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side. Rotate your forearm across your belly. Move slowly through a comfortable range. Return to the start and repeat 8-12 times. Switch arms.

Move slowly through a comfortable range.

name: seated radial nerve mobilization
instructions: Sit tall with one arm down at your side, palm facing back. Lower your shoulder slightly and rotate your arm inward. Bend your wrist gently and tilt your head away. Move slowly and stop at a mild pull, never pain. Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

instructions: Sit tall and lift one arm out to the side, palm up. Extend your wrist and fingers backward. Tilt your head slightly away from that arm. Return slowly and repeat 8-10 times. Stay within a mild stretch, then switch arms.

Extend your wrist and fingers backward.

name: seated ulnar nerve mobilization
instructions: Sit tall with one arm out to the side. Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask. Tilt your head slightly away. Straighten the arm back out, keeping it gentle. Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask.

name: barbell staggered stance stiff legged deadlift
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot. Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee. Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back. Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand. Finish all reps, then switch the stance.

name: flutter kicks v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips. Lift both legs a few inches off the floor. Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves. Press your lower back into the floor. Continue for 20-40 seconds.

name: balance 3 point toe tap
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and your hands on your hips. Tap the free foot out in front of you, then lightly out to the side. Tap it behind you, keeping your torso upright. Return to center and repeat the sequence under control. Complete all reps, then switch legs.

name: single arm fingers press with ball
instructions: Hold a small ball in one palm. Press down on it with your fingers. Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral. Hold the press for 2-3 seconds. Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

name: kneeling isometric biceps hold
instructions: Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees. Hold your hands in front of you with palms up. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides. Squeeze your biceps and hold the position. Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

name: backward press shoulders mobilization
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides. Press one arm backward, keeping the elbow straight. Move through a comfortable range. Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times. Switch arms.

name: external rotation shoulders mobilization
instructions: Stand tall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side. Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly. Keep your elbow tucked in. Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times. Switch arms.

name: forward press shoulders mobilization
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent in front of you. Press your arm forward until it is straight. Keep your shoulder relaxed. Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times. Switch arms.

name: bent over back to side to front arms raise
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang down. Sweep both arms back behind your hips. Swing them out wide to the sides up to shoulder height. Continue the arc forward until your arms point ahead of you, then reverse the path. Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly for the planned reps.

instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest. Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you. Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement. Slowly release the handles and return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball in both hands at chest level. Bend your knees slightly and engage your core. Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from knee to head.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.

name: lateral side plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your legs straight. Stack your feet or stagger them for balance. Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to feet. Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging. Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your legs straight.
Stack your feet or stagger them for balance.
Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to feet.

name: inchworm
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart. Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the ground in front of you. Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position, with your body in a straight line from head to toe. Pause for a moment, then walk your hands back towards your feet, keeping your legs as straight as possible. Once your hands reach your feet, stand back up to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the ground in front of you.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position, with your body in a straight line from head to toe.

name: forward jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position. Swing your arms back for momentum. Jump forward explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles. Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next jump. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.

name: backward jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees slightly and jump backwards, pushing off with both feet. Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees to absorb the impact. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump backwards, pushing off with both feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees to absorb the impact.

name: one leg squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Extend one leg forward, keeping it off the ground. Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair. Keep your chest up and your back straight. Push through your heel to return to the starting position. Repeat with the other leg.

Extend one leg forward, keeping it off the ground.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair.

Push through your heel to return to the starting position.

name: jack plank
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders. Brace your core and keep your hips level. Jump your feet apart, then jump them back together. Keep your upper body steady and your hips from rising. Continue at a steady pace for the planned time.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet apart, then jump them back together.

Continue at a steady pace for the planned time.

name: lever incline chest press v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest angle on the leverage machine to a comfortable position. Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Push the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are fully extended, but without locking your elbows. Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your elbows and lower the handles back towards your chest. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: biceps stretch behind the back
instructions: Stand tall and reach both arms behind your back. Straighten your elbows and turn your palms down or clasp your hands. Lift your hands slightly away from your body until you feel a stretch in the biceps. Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed. Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.

Straighten your elbows and turn your palms down or clasp your hands.

name: bow yoga pose
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your arms along your sides. Bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles. Lift your chest and kick your feet gently into your hands to raise your thighs. Keep your gaze forward and breathe steadily. Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release slowly and rest on the mat.

name: cobra yoga pose
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your palms under your shoulders and legs extended. Press the tops of your feet into the floor. Lift your chest by straightening your arms partway, keeping your hips down. Keep your shoulders away from your ears and your neck long. Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: full lotus yoga pose
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended. Bring one foot onto the opposite thigh, then the other foot on top of the other thigh. Only go as far as your hips allow, and never force your knees. Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine. Hold for 20-30 seconds with calm breathing, then switch the leg order next time.

Only go as far as your hips allow, and never force your knees.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.

name: locust yoga pose (iron man pose)
instructions: Lie face down with your arms along your sides and palms facing up. Press your pelvis into the floor and engage your glutes. Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together. Look slightly forward and keep your neck long. Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly and rest.

Press your pelvis into the floor and engage your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together.

name: plow yoga pose
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides. Lift your legs and hips up and over, supporting your lower back with your hands if needed. Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head. Keep your neck relaxed and do not turn your head. Hold for 15-30 seconds, then roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.

Lift your legs and hips up and over, supporting your lower back with your hands if needed.
Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head.
Keep your neck relaxed and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.

name: push up (with push up handles)
instructions: Place the handles shoulder-width apart and grip them in a plank position. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest until it is between the handles, elbows about 45 degrees from your body. Press back up until your arms are straight. Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

name: shoulder stand yoga pose
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your legs overhead, supporting your lower back with your hands. Walk your hands up toward your shoulder blades. Raise your legs straight up so your body forms a line over your shoulders. Keep your neck long and still, and do not turn your head. Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: shoulder stretch behind the back
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back. Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together. Lift your hands gently away from your body until you feel a stretch. Keep your chest open and avoid arching your lower back. Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.

name: sissy squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed. Slowly lower your body by bending your knees and leaning back, keeping your torso upright. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as far as you can comfortably go. Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: standing calf raise (on a staircase)
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step or a sturdy platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step. Hold onto a railing or wall for balance if needed. Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: supine spinal twist yoga pose
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides. Pull one knee toward your chest. Guide that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side. Keep both shoulders on the floor and turn your head the other way if comfortable. Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

Pull one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.

name: triceps dip stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall and raise one arm overhead. Bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head. Use your other hand to gently press the elbow back and down. Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back. Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

Bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.

name: wheel pose yoga pose
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat near your hips. Place your palms beside your head with fingers pointing toward your shoulders. Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips and then your head. Straighten your arms as far as comfortable and keep your thighs parallel. Hold for 5-15 seconds, then lower slowly with your chin tucked.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat near your hips.

Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips and then your head.

name: butterfly yoga pose
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall out to the sides. Hold onto your ankles or feet with your hands. Sit up tall and lengthen your spine. Gently press your knees down towards the floor, feeling a stretch in your inner thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths. To release, slowly bring your knees back up and extend your legs.

name: oblique crunch v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest. Engage your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the ground, rotating your torso to one side. Pause for a moment, then lower your shoulder blades back down to the starting position. Repeat on the other side. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: sledge hammer
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the sledge hammer with both hands. Engage your core and keep your back straight. Swing the sledge hammer down towards the ground, using your core and upper body strength. As you swing down, pivot your hips and transfer the force to the hammer. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: barbell reverse band bench press
instructions: Set up on a bench with bands anchored to the rack and attached to the bar. Lie back with your eyes under the bar and your shoulder blades pinched. Lower the bar to your mid chest with control. Press the bar back up to straight arms, feeling the band resistance change. Keep your feet planted and your wrists stacked over your elbows.

name: band decline sit up
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and hold the other end at your chest. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured. Curl your torso up toward your knees, keeping tension on the band. Pause at the top without pulling on your neck. Lower back down slowly under control.

name: band behind neck shoulder press
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at the back of your shoulders. Brace your core and keep your head forward. Press your hands straight up until your arms are extended. Lower slowly back behind your head to shoulder level. Only use this variation if your shoulders move comfortably in that position.

Lower slowly back behind your head to shoulder level.

name: band upright row (under two feet)
instructions: Stand with both feet on the middle of the band and hold the ends in front of your thighs. Keep your chest up and your core tight. Pull your hands up along your body until they reach chest height, elbows leading. Pause briefly without shrugging too high. Lower slowly back down.

name: band side plank row with partner
instructions: Get into a side plank on one forearm, with a partner holding the band in front of you. Grip the band with your top hand and keep your hips lifted. Row your hand back toward your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blade. Return slowly without letting your hips drop. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: band pushdown
instructions: Anchor the band high and hold the ends with your elbows at your sides. Stand tall with a slight forward lean. Push your hands down until your arms are straight. Pause and squeeze your triceps. Return slowly while keeping your elbows pinned to your sides.

name: band pull apart
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with your arms straight. Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears. Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end. Return slowly with control.

name: band skull crusher
instructions: Anchor the band behind your head and lie on your back holding the ends. Start with your arms straight above your chest. Bend only your elbows to lower your hands toward your forehead. Extend your arms back up against the band. Keep your upper arms still throughout.

name: band calf raise v. 3
instructions: Secure the band under your feet or around your shoulders as set up. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can. Pause and squeeze your calves. Lower slowly until your heels are back on the floor.

name: band ez barbell close grip curl
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the EZ bar with a close grip, palms up. Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall. Curl the bar up toward your shoulders. Squeeze at the top without swinging. Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: band hip flexion
instructions: Attach a band to a low anchor and loop it around one ankle. Stand tall and hold a support for balance. Lift the knee forward and up toward hip height. Pause briefly, then lower with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

name: band lateral raise v. 2

name: barbell bench squat (with chains)
instructions: Set a bench behind you and load the bar with chains. Place the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Sit back and down until you touch the bench lightly. Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes. Drive through your feet to stand, feeling the chains add weight.

name: crossover reverse lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips. Step one foot back and across behind your other leg. Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees. Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable. Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat or switch sides.

Step one foot back and across behind your other leg.

name: hamstring stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Step forward with your right foot and shift your weight onto your right leg. Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the hips, reaching towards your right foot with both hands. Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position. Repeat on the other side.

name: all fours squad stretch
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips. Extend one leg straight back, keeping your knee bent and your foot flexed. Slowly lower your hips towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your quads. Hold this position for 20-30 seconds. Switch legs and repeat the stretch on the other side.

name: band good morning
instructions: Stand on the band and loop it behind your neck across your shoulders. Keep your knees softly bent and your back flat. Push your hips back and lean your torso forward. Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.

Push your hips back and lean your torso forward.

name: barbell quarter squat
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Brace your core and keep your chest up. Bend your knees and hips a short way, about a quarter of the full depth. Keep your knees tracking over your toes. Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

name: barbell clean deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip just outside your knees. Set a flat back, chest up and shoulders over the bar. Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close to your legs. Stand tall with hips and knees fully extended. Lower the bar back down with control along the same path.

Lower the bar back down with control along the same path.

name: barbell clean from blocks
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back. Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body. Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders. Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a full squat. Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

name: barbell clean pull
instructions: Set up over the bar with a flat back and a grip just outside your knees. Lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close. Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug. Let your elbows rise high, but do not catch the bar. Lower the bar with control and reset.

name: barbell decline bench lunge
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back and rest one foot behind you on a decline bench. Step the front foot out to set a stable stance. Lower your back knee toward the floor, torso upright. Drive through the front foot to rise. Finish your reps, then switch legs.

Step the front foot out to set a stable stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to rise.

name: smith good morning off pins
instructions: Set the bar on the pins at upper-chest height and duck under it. Stand tall with the bar on your upper back and knees slightly bent. Push your hips back, keeping your back flat. Stop when your torso is near parallel with the floor. Drive your hips forward to stand, then return the bar to the pins when done.

Stand tall with the bar on your upper back and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back, keeping your back flat.

Drive your hips forward to stand, then return the bar to the pins when done.

name: barbell hang clean
instructions: Stand holding the bar at mid-thigh with a grip just outside your legs and a flat back. Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body. Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders. Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat. Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.

instructions: Hold the bar just below your knees with a flat back and your shoulders over the bar. Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body. Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders. Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat. Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.

name: barbell hang snatch
instructions: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a wide snatch grip and a flat back. Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body. Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders. name: lever one leg extension

name: sled 45° narrow stance leg press

name: leg up hamstring stretch

name: lying hip flexor

name: one leg quarter squat

name: sled one leg hack squat
instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat sled with your back and shoulders against the pads. Place one foot in the middle of the platform and keep the other foot off. name: prisoner squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head. Pull your elbows back and keep your chest up. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down. Go until your thighs are about parallel to the floor. Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: bodyweight rear lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees. Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted. Push through your front foot to return to standing. Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side first.

name: reclining big toe pose with rope
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. Loop the rope around the ball of your right foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands. name: rocket jump

name: runners stretch

name: side to side box shuffle

name: single leg push off

name: single leg stride jump

name: sit squat

name: smith frankenstein squat
instructions: Set the bar at upper chest height and rest it on your front shoulders. Extend your arms straight forward, like a zombie, to keep the bar in place. instructions: Set the bar at waist height and hook your elbows under it with your arms crossed. Unrack and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. name: standing hamstring and calf stretch with strap

name: world greatest stretch

name: cable triceps pushdown (sz bar)

name: dumbbell close grip press
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs. Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position. As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells to your side until they are about level with your chest. As you exhale, use your triceps to lift the dumbbells back to the starting position. Make sure to use only your triceps and do not use your forearms or biceps to help lift the dumbbells. After a second pause at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: dumbbell twisting bench press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you. Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows. Lower the dumbbells down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body. As you lower the dumbbells, twist your wrists so that your palms face towards you at the bottom of the movement. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then reverse the movement by pressing the dumbbells back up to the starting position. As you press the dumbbells up, twist your wrists back to the starting position with palms facing away from you. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: exercise ball dip
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle. Place your hands on the ball beside your hips, fingers pointing forward. Engage your triceps and push through your hands to lift your body off the ball, straightening your arms. Lower your body back down by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides. name: exercise ball seated triceps stretch
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight. Hold a dumbbell in one hand and extend your arm straight up above your head. name: exercise ball supine triceps extension
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, then walk forward until your upper back rests on the ball. Lift your hips level and press the dumbbells straight up, palms facing each other. Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head. Straighten your arms to press them back up. Keep your hips up for the whole set.

name: barbell pin presses
instructions: Set up a barbell on a power rack at chest height. Stand facing the barbell and position yourself underneath it, with your feet shoulder-width apart. Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest, with your arms fully extended. Lower the barbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body. Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest. Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: smith machine incline tricep extension

Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Extend your arms fully, lifting the bar off the rack and holding it directly above your chest. name: three bench dip

name: barbell single leg deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip. Shift your weight onto your left foot and lift your right foot slightly off the ground. Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your right leg extended behind you for balance. Lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body and your left leg slightly bent. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the ground. Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground. At the same time, extend your right leg straight behind you, maintaining a slight bend in your left knee. Lower the dumbbell until your torso and right leg are parallel to the ground. Pause for a moment, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards. Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: single leg squat (pistol) male
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you. Lift your right foot off the ground and extend it forward. Slowly lower your body down by bending your left knee and pushing your hips back. Keep your chest up and your back straight as you lower yourself down. Lower until your left thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands. Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat on the other side, twisting your torso in the opposite direction. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

instructions: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands. Lift one leg out in front of you and balance on the other. Sit your hips back and bend your knee, lowering as far as you can control. Keep your heel down and your knee tracking over your toes. Press through your foot to stand, using the support only as needed, then switch legs.

name: shoulder adductor protractor and elevator stretch

instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out. Keep your heels near your hips. Drive through the feet to lift your hips. Squeeze your glutes at the top. Lower slowly and repeat.

Drive through the feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

name: cable stand up
instructions: Hold the cable handle at your chest and sit back into a deep squat. Keep your chest tall. Push through your heels to stand fully. Squeeze your glutes at the top. Lower with control.

Push through your heels to stand fully.

name: resistance band hip thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band over your hips, anchored at both sides. Plant your feet flat. Drive your hips up against the band. Squeeze your glutes at the top. Lower slowly.

name: ankle dorsal flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Sit with one leg out and your heel resting on the floor. Pull your toes and the top of your foot toward your shin as far as is comfortable. Pause briefly, then lower the foot back down slowly. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: ankle plantar flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Sit with one leg out and your foot relaxed. Point your toes down and away from you, as if pressing a gas pedal. Pause briefly at the end, then return to the neutral position. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: elbow extension
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Hold your upper arm still with the elbow bent. Straighten the arm slowly until it is almost fully extended. Pause briefly, keeping the shoulder relaxed and the upper arm fixed. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: elbow flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Start with your arm straight down at your side, palm forward. Bend the elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder. Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly without swinging. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: forearm pronation
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing up. Rotate your forearm so your palm turns down to face the floor. Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Rotate your forearm so your palm turns down to face the floor.

name: forearm supination
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing down. Rotate your forearm so your palm turns up to face the ceiling. Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: hip abduction
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg. Lift the other leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward. Pause briefly, then lower slowly without leaning your torso. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: hip adduction
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg. Lift the other leg slightly out to the side. Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Lift the other leg slightly out to the side.
Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: hip extension
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg. Swing the other leg straight back, keeping your knee mostly straight. Squeeze the glute at the top, avoiding any arching of your lower back. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: hip flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg. Lift the other knee up in front of you toward hip height. Pause briefly, then lower slowly without rounding your back. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: hip lateral rotation (external rotation)
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees. Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg inward, which rotates the hip outward. Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: hip medial rotation (internal rotation)
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees. Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg outward, which rotates the hip inward. Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: knee extension
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Sit tall on a bench or chair with your feet off the floor. Straighten one knee until the leg is almost fully extended. Squeeze your thigh at the top, then lower slowly. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: knee flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg. Bend the other knee to bring your heel up toward your glutes. Keep your thighs side by side, pause, then lower slowly. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder abduction
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall with your arms at your sides. Raise one arm out to the side up to about shoulder height. Lower slowly without shrugging. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
instruction_steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.

name: shoulder adduction
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall with one arm raised out to the side at shoulder height. Pull the arm down toward your side with control. Keep your torso still and finish with the arm next to your body. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder extension
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall with your arm straight down at your side. Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight. Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight.
Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall with your arms at your sides, palms facing in. Raise one arm forward and up to about shoulder height or higher. Keep your ribs down, then lower slowly. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
instruction_steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides, palms facing in.
Raise one arm forward and up to about shoulder height or higher.
Keep your ribs down, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder lateral rotation (external rotation)
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward. Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side. Pause briefly, then return slowly. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder medial rotation (internal rotation)
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward. Rotate your forearm inward across your stomach, keeping the elbow tucked in. Pause briefly, then return slowly. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm inward across your stomach, keeping the elbow tucked in.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder transverse abduction
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall with one arm held out in front at shoulder height. Sweep the arm out and back in a horizontal arc as far as is comfortable. Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder transverse adduction
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall with one arm held out to the side at shoulder height. Sweep the arm forward and across your body in a horizontal arc. Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder transverse extension
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall with your arm held in front at shoulder height. Pull the arm back and out to the side, keeping it level. Squeeze your shoulder blade lightly, then return slowly. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: shoulder transverse flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand tall with your arm held out to the side at shoulder height. Bring the arm forward in front of your chest, keeping it level. Pause briefly, then return slowly to the side. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: spine (lumbar) extension
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips. Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range. Pause briefly, then return upright. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range.

name: spine (lumbar) flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand with feet hip width apart and knees slightly soft. Round your lower back forward and tuck your chin and pelvis in. Pause briefly, then return upright. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Round your lower back forward and tuck your chin and pelvis in.

name: spine (lumbar) lateral flexion
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms at your sides. Slide one hand down the outside of your leg as you bend sideways. Keep your hips level, return to upright, then bend to the other side. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms at your sides.

name: spine (lumbar) rotation
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms crossed over your chest. Rotate your torso to one side while keeping the hips facing forward. Return to center, then rotate to the other side. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

Rotate your torso to one side while keeping the hips facing forward.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: wrist adduction
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position. Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, thumb up. Tilt your hand down toward the little finger side. Pause briefly, then return to neutral under control. Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

name: wrist extension

name: plank jump
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders. Jump both feet out wide. Jump them back together. Keep your hips level and core tight. Move at a steady pace.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and core tight.
Move at a steady pace.

name: plank walk up
instructions: Start in a forearm plank. Place one hand and then the other on the floor to rise to a high plank. Lower one forearm and then the other back down. Keep your hips steady. Alternate the leading arm each rep.
instruction_steps: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand and then the other on the floor to rise to a high plank.
Lower one forearm and then the other back down.
Keep your hips steady.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.

name: dumbbell step up lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy box or step. Step one foot onto the box and drive up until you stand on it. Step the same foot back down behind you into a lunge. Push back up to the start, keeping your torso upright. Finish all reps on one leg, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Step one foot onto the box and drive up until you stand on it.
Step the same foot back down behind you into a lunge.
Push back up to the start, keeping your torso upright.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch sides.

name: dumbbell step-up lunge
instructions: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides. Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is on the surface. Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the step, bringing your left foot up as well. Once both feet are on the step, lower your left foot back down to the starting position, keeping your right foot on the step. Repeat the movement, alternating which foot you step up with each time. Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is on the surface.
Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the step, bringing your left foot up as well.
Once both feet are on the step, lower your left foot back down to the starting position, keeping your right foot on the step.
Repeat the movement, alternating which foot you step up with each time.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.

name: barbell squat jump step rear lunge v. 2
instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart. Squat down, then jump up lightly and land softly. Step one foot back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor. Push through the front foot to return to standing. Alternate legs on each rep, keeping your chest tall.
instruction_steps: Rest the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down, then jump up lightly and land softly.
Step one foot back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep, keeping your chest tall.

name: barbell squat jump step rear lunge
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back. Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back. Explode upwards, jumping off the ground as high as you can. Land softly on your feet and immediately step back with one leg into a reverse lunge. Lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat the jump and lunge sequence on the other leg. Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Explode upwards, jumping off the ground as high as you can.
Land softly on your feet and immediately step back with one leg into a reverse lunge.
Lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat the jump and lunge sequence on the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

name: barbell sitted alternate leg raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs. Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping the other leg on the ground. Lower the raised leg back down and repeat with the other leg. Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping the other leg on the ground.
Lower the raised leg back down and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

name: barbell sitted alternate leg raise (female)
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs. Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support. Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping it parallel to the ground. Lower the leg back down and repeat with the other leg. Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping it parallel to the ground.
Lower the leg back down and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

name: twisted leg raise (female)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, bringing them towards your chest. As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your knees towards your opposite shoulder. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position. Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, bringing them towards your chest.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your knees towards your opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: twisted leg raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. Place your hands under your glutes for support. Engage your abs and lift both legs off the ground, keeping them straight. As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your legs towards your opposite shoulder. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position. Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your abs and lift both legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your legs towards your opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.

name: dumbbell supported squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a stable support. Stand with feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out. name: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Place your left foot on a stepbox or elevated surface behind you. As you lower the dumbbell, simultaneously lift your left leg behind you, maintaining a straight line from head to heel. Lower the dumbbell until you feel a stretch in your right hamstring, then return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, then lower the dumbbell back down between your legs. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back and step into a split stance. Keep your torso upright and core braced. Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor. Press through your front foot to rise. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

instructions: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body. Pull the dumbbells up close to your body and rotate your elbows under them. Catch them on your shoulders in a slight quarter squat. Stand tall, then lower them back to your thighs and reset.

name: suspender wide grip inverted row
instructions: Hold the handles of a suspension trainer with a wide overhand grip and lean back, arms straight. Walk your feet forward to set the difficulty. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades. Pause briefly at the top. Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.

name: suspension wide grip inverted row on floor
instructions: Hold the handles with a wide, overhand grip and lie back with your body straight. Keep your heels on the floor and your core tight. name: band bent over wide grip row
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip width apart and grab it with a wide overhand grip. Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees. Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows flaring out. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top. Lower slowly until your arms are straight. Keep your torso still throughout.

name: band one arm standing wide grip low row
instructions: Anchor a band low and stand facing it, holding the end in one hand. Step back until the band is taut, feet hip width apart. Pull your elbow back and out, leading with the elbow. Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine. Return slowly to a straight arm. Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: band seated wide grip row
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and loop the band around your feet. Grab the band with a wide grip and sit tall. Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared. Squeeze your shoulder blades together. Return slowly with control and repeat.

name: 45 degrees back extension
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers. Cross your arms over your chest or hold them behind your head. Avoid over-arching at the top.

instructions: Set your feet on the platform with your thighs against the pad and knees just behind it. Start with your torso hanging down and your body straight. name: dumbbell side bridge with bent leg
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder. Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting on your hip. instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked. Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line. Keep your core tight and your neck neutral. Hold for 20-40 seconds without letting your hips sag. Lower down and repeat on the other side.

name: lying ab press
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended. Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor. Lift your shoulders and bring your knees toward your chest. Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze. Return slowly without letting your feet touch down. Repeat for reps.

name: roll ball foot
instructions: Place the ball under your foot sole while seated or standing. Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
