name: child to cobra pose
instructions: Start in child pose, knees apart, arms stretched forward. Shift forward and lower your chest toward the floor. Slide forward and press into your hands to lift your chest into cobra. Keep your hips down and your shoulders away from your ears. Hold for a few breaths. Push back into child pose and repeat.
instruction_steps: Start in child pose, knees apart, arms stretched forward.
Shift forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Slide forward and press into your hands to lift your chest into cobra.
Keep your hips down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a few breaths.
Push back into child pose and repeat.

name: kneeling lat stretch on bench
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench and place both elbows on top of it. Keep your hands together or hold a light stick. Sit your hips back and let your chest sink toward the floor. Keep your lower back relaxed. Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly. Come back up carefully.
instruction_steps: Kneel in front of a bench and place both elbows on top of it.
Keep your hands together or hold a light stick.
Sit your hips back and let your chest sink toward the floor.
Keep your lower back relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Come back up carefully.

name: body extension
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your body upright. Cross your arms or put your hands on your hips. Squeeze your glutes and lean back from the knees as one straight line. Go back as far as you can control. Pull yourself back up to the start. Keep your hips forward.
instruction_steps: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your body upright.
Cross your arms or put your hands on your hips.
Squeeze your glutes and lean back from the knees as one straight line.
Go back as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to the start.
Keep your hips forward.

name: bodyweight elevated heel squat
instructions: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet shoulder-width apart. Hold your arms in front for balance. Bend your knees and sink down with your chest tall. Let your knees travel forward over your toes. Drive back up through your whole foot. Keep your core tight throughout.
instruction_steps: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knees and sink down with your chest tall.
Let your knees travel forward over your toes.
Drive back up through your whole foot.
Keep your core tight throughout.

name: dumbbell cossack squats
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with a wide stance. Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight. Sit deep with your chest up and the straight leg's toes pointing up. Push through the bent leg to return to the center. Move into the other side. Alternate sides with control.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with a wide stance.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Sit deep with your chest up and the straight leg's toes pointing up.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center.
Move into the other side.
Alternate sides with control.

name: dumbbell squat hold calf raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and sink into a half squat. Keep your chest tall and weight over your feet. Lift your heels as high as you can. Pause briefly at the top. Lower your heels slowly without standing up. Stay in the squat for the full set.
instruction_steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides and sink into a half squat.
Keep your chest tall and weight over your feet.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly without standing up.
Stay in the squat for the full set.

name: dumbbell squat lunges jump complex
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Do a squat and stand back up. Step into a lunge on each leg. Finish with a jump, landing softly with bent knees. Continue the chain without putting the weights down. Rest, then repeat the sequence.
instruction_steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Do a squat and stand back up.
Step into a lunge on each leg.
Finish with a jump, landing softly with bent knees.
Continue the chain without putting the weights down.
Rest, then repeat the sequence.

name: dumbbell step up with knee raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand facing a bench or box. Place one foot fully on the box. Push through that heel and step up. Lift the other knee toward your chest at the top. Step down with control. Finish your reps, then switch legs.
instruction_steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand facing a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel and step up.
Lift the other knee toward your chest at the top.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: cable neutral grip kickback
instructions: Set a low cable with a neutral grip handle and hinge forward at the hips. Pin your upper arm against your side. Hold the handle with your palm facing in. Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight. Squeeze your triceps for a moment. Return slowly and switch arms after the set.
instruction_steps: Set a low cable with a neutral grip handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Pin your upper arm against your side.
Hold the handle with your palm facing in.
Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

name: cable bent over single arm neutral grip kickback with rope attachment
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end with a neutral grip. Hinge at the hips with a flat back. Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and tucked in. Straighten your elbow and pull the rope back. Squeeze at the end of the motion. Lower slowly, then switch arms.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end with a neutral grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and tucked in.
Straighten your elbow and pull the rope back.
Squeeze at the end of the motion.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

name: resistance band pull apart
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height, arms straight. Keep your hands about shoulder-width apart. Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides. Squeeze your shoulder blades together. Return slowly to the start. Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.
instruction_steps: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height, arms straight.
Keep your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

name: resistance band one arm bent over row
instructions: Stand on the band with a staggered stance and hinge forward. Hold the handle in one hand with your arm extended. Brace your core and keep your back flat. Pull your elbow back toward your hip. Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top. Lower slowly, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Stand on the band with a staggered stance and hinge forward.
Hold the handle in one hand with your arm extended.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

name: resistance band bent over neutral grip row
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward. Hold the handles with a neutral grip, arms straight. Keep your back flat and neck neutral. Pull both handles toward your lower ribs. Squeeze your shoulder blades together. Lower with control.
instruction_steps: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward.
Hold the handles with a neutral grip, arms straight.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Pull both handles toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

name: resistance band push up
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your hands. Get into a plank position with your body straight. Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees. Press up against the band until your arms are straight. Keep your core tight and hips level. Lower slowly for the next rep.
instruction_steps: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your hands.
Get into a plank position with your body straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up against the band until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.
Lower slowly for the next rep.

name: dumbbell half kneeling lift and chop
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a dumbbell with both hands. Start with the weight by your low outside hip. Lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder. Rotate your torso and keep your hips square. Chop it back down along the same line. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a dumbbell with both hands.
Start with the weight by your low outside hip.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Chop it back down along the same line.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: band half kneeling chop
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel on one knee side-on to the anchor. Hold the band with both hands near your high shoulder. Pull the band diagonally down across your body. Rotate your torso and keep your hips square. Return slowly to the start. Complete your reps, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Anchor a band high and kneel on one knee side-on to the anchor.
Hold the band with both hands near your high shoulder.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

name: dumbbell standing biceps curl to shoulder press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward. Curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders. Rotate your palms to face forward at the top of the curl. Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight. Lower them back to your shoulders, then down to your sides. Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.
instruction_steps: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms to face forward at the top of the curl.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders, then down to your sides.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

name: band standing single arm row
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand facing it. Hold the band in one hand with your arm extended. Step back until there is tension and brace your core. Pull your elbow back past your ribs. Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine. Return slowly, then switch arms.
instruction_steps: Anchor a band at chest height and stand facing it.
Hold the band in one hand with your arm extended.
Step back until there is tension and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

name: band standing straight arm pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the ends with arms extended in front of you. Stand with a slight forward lean and a braced core. Keep your arms nearly straight. Pull the band down in an arc until your hands reach your thighs. Squeeze your lats. Return slowly to the start.
instruction_steps: Anchor a band overhead and hold the ends with arms extended in front of you.
Stand with a slight forward lean and a braced core.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull the band down in an arc until your hands reach your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

name: dumbbell half kneeling military press
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front and dumbbells at your shoulders. Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg. Brace your core and keep your ribs down. Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight. Lower slowly to shoulder height. Switch your lead leg halfway through or on the next set.
instruction_steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
Switch your lead leg halfway through or on the next set.

name: cable bent over neutral grip kickback with rope attachment
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold both ends. Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back. Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and close to your sides. Straighten your elbows and spread the rope slightly at the end. Squeeze your triceps. Return slowly to the start.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold both ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows and spread the rope slightly at the end.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

name: bodyweight step up on stepbox
instructions: Stand facing a step box with feet hip-width apart. Place one foot fully on the box. Push through your heel to step up and stand tall. Bring the other foot up to meet it. Step down with control. Finish your reps, then switch the lead leg.
instruction_steps: Stand facing a step box with feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through your heel to step up and stand tall.
Bring the other foot up to meet it.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch the lead leg.

name: cat cow stretch
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Inhale and drop your belly, lifting your chest and tailbone into cow. Exhale and round your back toward the ceiling into cat. Tuck your chin and pull your belly in. Move slowly between the two positions. Repeat for 10-12 breaths.
instruction_steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and drop your belly, lifting your chest and tailbone into cow.
Exhale and round your back toward the ceiling into cat.
Tuck your chin and pull your belly in.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 10-12 breaths.

name: boxing block
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with feet staggered and knees slightly bent. Bring your fists up to your cheeks with elbows tucked in. Keep your chin down. Raise your forearms to cover your face as if blocking a punch. Bring your elbows together to cover your ribs. Reset to your guard and repeat.
instruction_steps: Stand in a boxing stance with feet staggered and knees slightly bent.
Bring your fists up to your cheeks with elbows tucked in.
Keep your chin down.
Raise your forearms to cover your face as if blocking a punch.
Bring your elbows together to cover your ribs.
Reset to your guard and repeat.

name: boxing jab (with boxing bag)
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag with your hands up. Extend your lead hand straight toward the bag. Rotate your fist so the palm faces down on impact. Keep your rear hand guarding your chin. Snap the punch back to your guard right away. Stay light on your feet and repeat.
instruction_steps: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag with your hands up.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the bag.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down on impact.
Keep your rear hand guarding your chin.
Snap the punch back to your guard right away.
Stay light on your feet and repeat.

name: boxing right cross (with boxing bag)
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag. Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand. Drive your fist straight to the bag. Rotate your shoulder and keep your chin tucked. Keep your lead hand up to guard. Snap back to your stance and repeat.
instruction_steps: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the bag.
Rotate your shoulder and keep your chin tucked.
Keep your lead hand up to guard.
Snap back to your stance and repeat.

name: boxing right hook (with boxing bag)
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag. Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees. Rotate your hips and torso to swing the fist in an arc. Pivot your rear foot as you turn. Hit the bag and keep your left hand guarding. Return to your guard and repeat.
instruction_steps: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Rotate your hips and torso to swing the fist in an arc.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Hit the bag and keep your left hand guarding.
Return to your guard and repeat.

name: front groin kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag with hands up. Lift your rear knee toward your chest. Extend your leg and drive the ball of your foot into the bag. Lean back slightly to stay balanced. Pull your leg back quickly. Return to your stance and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag with hands up.
Lift your rear knee toward your chest.
Extend your leg and drive the ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly to stay balanced.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Return to your stance and switch sides.

name: front kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag. Lift your rear knee up in front of you. Extend your leg and push your heel or ball of your foot into the bag. Lean back slightly and keep your guard up. Pull the leg back to bend it. Plant your foot and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Lift your rear knee up in front of you.
Extend your leg and push your heel or ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly and keep your guard up.
Pull the leg back to bend it.
Plant your foot and switch sides.

name: front snap kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag. Raise your knee quickly. Snap your lower leg out to hit the bag with the ball of your foot. Recoil right away to bend the knee again. Keep your hands up. Set your foot down and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the bag with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

name: hook kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag. Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out to the side. Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc. Hit the bag with the top of your foot or shin. Keep your hands up and your torso steady. Bring the leg back and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out to the side.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc.
Hit the bag with the top of your foot or shin.
Keep your hands up and your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

name: boxing jab (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height. Stand in a boxing stance with hands up. Throw your lead hand straight to the pad. Rotate your fist so the palm faces down. Retract your hand quickly to your guard. Keep your feet light and repeat.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Throw your lead hand straight to the pad.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down.
Retract your hand quickly to your guard.
Keep your feet light and repeat.

name: boxing left uppercut (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them. Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly. Dip slightly and drive up through your legs. Rotate your hips as you bring your left fist up in a tight arc. Hit the pad with the palm facing you. Reset your guard.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Rotate your hips as you bring your left fist up in a tight arc.
Hit the pad with the palm facing you.
Reset your guard.

name: boxing right cross (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height. Stand in a boxing stance with hands up. Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand. Drive your fist straight to the pad. Keep your chin tucked and left hand up. Snap back to your stance.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the pad.
Keep your chin tucked and left hand up.
Snap back to your stance.

name: boxing right hook (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad out to the side. Stand in a boxing stance with hands up. Bend your right elbow and rotate your hips and torso. Swing the fist in an arc into the pad. Pivot your rear foot as you turn. Return to your guard.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad out to the side.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your right elbow and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing the fist in an arc into the pad.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Return to your guard.

name: boxing right uppercut (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them. Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly. Drive up through your legs and rotate your hips. Bring your right fist up in a tight arc to the pad. Keep your left hand guarding. Reset your stance.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and rotate your hips.
Bring your right fist up in a tight arc to the pad.
Keep your left hand guarding.
Reset your stance.

name: front kick kickboxing (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad at body height. Stand in a fighting stance with hands up. Raise your rear knee in front of you. Extend your leg and push the ball of your foot into the pad. Pull your leg back quickly. Switch sides after your reps.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad at body height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Raise your rear knee in front of you.
Extend your leg and push the ball of your foot into the pad.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Switch sides after your reps.

name: front knee kick kickboxing (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at waist height. Stand in a fighting stance with hands up. Drive your rear knee up and forward into the pad. Rise slightly onto the toes of your standing foot. Keep your torso upright. Lower the leg and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad at waist height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Drive your rear knee up and forward into the pad.
Rise slightly onto the toes of your standing foot.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower the leg and switch sides.

name: front snap kick kickboxing (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at body height. Raise your knee quickly. Snap your lower leg out to hit the pad with the ball of your foot. Recoil right away to bend the knee again. Keep your hands up. Set your foot down and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a pad at body height.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the pad with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

name: hook kick kickboxing (with partner)
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad to the side. Stand in a fighting stance with hands up. Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out. Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc into the pad. Keep your torso steady. Bring the leg back and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad to the side.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc into the pad.
Keep your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

name: roll tensor fasciae latae
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the front of your outer hip. Support yourself with your forearm and opposite foot. Slowly roll up and down a few inches. Pause on tender spots for a few seconds. Breathe slowly and keep the movement gentle. Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Lie on your side with the roller under the front of your outer hip.
Support yourself with your forearm and opposite foot.
Slowly roll up and down a few inches.
Pause on tender spots for a few seconds.
Breathe slowly and keep the movement gentle.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

name: roll iliopsoas
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under the front of one hip, just inside the hip bone. Support your weight on your forearms. Shift your weight gently over the roller. Roll slowly a small distance up and down. Pause on tight spots while breathing deeply. Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Lie face down with the roller under the front of one hip, just inside the hip bone.
Support your weight on your forearms.
Shift your weight gently over the roller.
Roll slowly a small distance up and down.
Pause on tight spots while breathing deeply.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

name: roll ball lower back
instructions: Lie on your back with a small ball under one side of your lower back. Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor. Shift your weight slowly so the ball rolls along the muscle next to the spine. Pause on tender spots for a few breaths, then move on. Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable, never on the spine itself.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with a small ball under one side of your lower back.
Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor.
Shift your weight slowly so the ball rolls along the muscle next to the spine.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths, then move on.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable, never on the spine itself.

name: open book stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms straight in front of you. Keep your knees together and lift the top arm up and over. Rotate your chest open toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes. Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly. Return the arm and repeat, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your knees together and lift the top arm up and over.
Rotate your chest open toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return the arm and repeat, then switch sides.

name: pvc external rotation
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe in both hands with your elbows tucked at your sides and bent to 90 degrees. Keep your elbows pinned and rotate the pipe so one hand moves outward. Return to the start and rotate the other way. Move slowly and keep your ribs down and your wrists straight. Continue alternating for the planned reps.
instruction_steps: Hold a PVC pipe in both hands with your elbows tucked at your sides and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned and rotate the pipe so one hand moves outward.
Return to the start and rotate the other way.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down and your wrists straight.
Continue alternating for the planned reps.

name: pvc front rack stretch
instructions: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip. Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can. Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching. Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily. Lower the elbows and repeat.
instruction_steps: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip.
Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the elbows and repeat.

name: pvc good morning
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a PVC pipe across your upper back. Soften your knees slightly and push your hips straight back. Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, keeping your back flat. Drive your hips forward to stand tall again. Keep the pipe in contact with your head, upper back and tailbone if you can.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a PVC pipe across your upper back.
Soften your knees slightly and push your hips straight back.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep the pipe in contact with your head, upper back and tailbone if you can.

name: pvc hip hinge
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe vertically along your spine, one hand at the neck and one at the lower back. Keep the pipe touching head, upper back and tailbone. Push your hips back with soft knees and tip forward. Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand. Keep the pipe contact the whole time.
instruction_steps: Hold a PVC pipe vertically along your spine, one hand at the neck and one at the lower back.
Keep the pipe touching head, upper back and tailbone.
Push your hips back with soft knees and tip forward.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep the pipe contact the whole time.

name: pvc overhead squat
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe overhead with a wide grip and arms locked out. Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders. Squat down by sitting between your hips, keeping the pipe over your mid-foot. Go as deep as you can with your chest up and heels down. Drive through your feet to stand back up.
instruction_steps: Hold a PVC pipe overhead with a wide grip and arms locked out.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders.
Squat down by sitting between your hips, keeping the pipe over your mid-foot.
Go as deep as you can with your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

name: pvc pass through
instructions: Stand holding a PVC pipe in front of your thighs with a wide overhand grip. Keep your arms straight and raise the pipe overhead. Continue moving it down behind your back as far as comfortable. Reverse the path back to the front with control. Widen your grip if the shoulders feel pinched.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a PVC pipe in front of your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the pipe overhead.
Continue moving it down behind your back as far as comfortable.
Reverse the path back to the front with control.
Widen your grip if the shoulders feel pinched.

name: shin box switch
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side. Sit tall and keep your hands on the floor if needed. Rotate your knees to the other side so the legs swap positions. Move smoothly without using your hands to push too hard. Repeat back and forth for the set.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side.
Sit tall and keep your hands on the floor if needed.
Rotate your knees to the other side so the legs swap positions.
Move smoothly without using your hands to push too hard.
Repeat back and forth for the set.

name: lying side to side knee
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent, feet flat. Keep your shoulders on the floor. Slowly drop both knees to one side as far as is comfortable. Bring them back to the middle and drop them to the other side. Move at an easy pace and breathe through each rep.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent, feet flat.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Slowly drop both knees to one side as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back to the middle and drop them to the other side.

name: roll ball deltoid posterior

name: meditation

name: mountain pose

Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid swinging.

Keep your chest up, then switch sides after your reps.

Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.

instructions: Attach a bar or handle to a low cable and hook it in the bends of your elbows, close to your chest. Stand facing away from the stack with your feet shoulder width apart. instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder width grip. Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead like a skull crusher. Use a lighter weight and keep your wrists straight.
